Cricket Squads Revised After Player Injuries

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) announced revised squads for the upcoming ODI series against England and the T20 series against Zimbabwe. Fast bowler Harshit Rana has been ruled out of the ODI series due to injury. Leg-spinner Varun Chakravarthy will not participate in the T20 series against Zimbabwe. Prince Yadav and Ravi Bishnoi have been named as replacements for the injured players.
